title: Scanning the documents directory on app startup

cues.en: So now that we've added this helper method, isUnder, and we also have this down here, moveToProcessed, let's take care of the easy thing first.
cues.zh: 已經加入 _is_under 輔助函式，以及下面的 _move_to_processed，先處理簡單的部分。

cues.en: When the application first starts, so somebody types Pyrag watch or something like that, what if they've already dropped documents
cues.zh: 當應用程式剛啟動，例如有人輸入 pyrag watch 時，如果他早已把文件

cues.en: into the documents directory to get processed?
cues.zh: 放進 documents 目錄，等待處理，怎麼辦？

cues.en: Well, of course, we want to scan those and ingest them right away, and that's really easy.
cues.zh: 當然希望立刻掃描並匯入它們，這很容易，

cues.en: We have everything we need to make that happen right now.
cues.zh: 現在已經有全部必要功能。

cues.en: What we can do is come down here.
cues.zh: 可以到這裡，

cues.en: It's not going to be a method.
cues.zh: 這次不建立方法，

cues.en: We'll put another function right here, okay?
cues.zh: 而是新增另一個函式，

cues.en: So right at the, go over to the far left as far as you can, and we'll define a function, and I'll call it initial scan, okay?
cues.zh: 所以回到最左邊，定義一個叫 initial_scan 的函式。

cues.en: And we'll call this an application startup, and all it's going to require is an ingester, and we already have one of those, so we'll just type hint that to ingester, right like that, okay?
cues.zh: 會在應用程式啟動時呼叫，只需要一個 ingestor；我們已經有了，型別就標註為 Ingestor。

cues.en: And this doesn't return anything, and it's a very simple function, okay?
cues.zh: 這個函式不回傳值，內容也很簡單。

cues.en: So without this, files dropped in while the watcher was off, they would be invisible until somebody actually touches them, and we always want to run an initial scan
cues.zh: 沒有它，監看器停用期間放入的檔案，在有人再次動到它們前都不會被發現；因此啟動時總要掃描一次，

cues.en: to make sure that what's on disk and what's in the store are in sync.
cues.zh: 確保磁碟與儲存區內容同步。

cues.en: That's the only thing we want to do.
cues.zh: 我們只想做這件事。

cues.en: So let's get the documents directory, and I'll store that in a variable called docs, and that's an ingester.config.documentsdir.
cues.zh: 先取得 documents 目錄，存進 docs 變數，值就是 ingestor.config.documents_dir。

cues.en: Okay, so I store that location in the docs variable, and then I get the same thing for processed.
cues.zh: 把位置存入 docs 後，再對 processed 做相同的事，

cues.en: Processed equals ingester.config.processdir.
cues.zh: processed = ingestor.config.processed_dir。

cues.en: So now I have where the documents are, the ones that are to be processed, and where they should go once they are processed, and all we have to do is go through all the contents of that directory.
cues.zh: 現在知道待處理文件在哪裡，也知道處理完要移到哪裡，只要遍歷該目錄的全部內容。

cues.en: So for path in sorted, we'll want to sort things.
cues.zh: for path in sorted，我們希望先排序，

cues.en: Docs, the documents directory, .iterdir, okay?
cues.zh: 再傳入 docs.iterdir()。

cues.en: So for that, what do we do?
cues.zh: 對每個項目要做什麼？

cues.en: Well, first of all, if it's a directory, we want to ignore it.
cues.zh: 首先，如果是目錄就忽略，

cues.en: If path.is__dir, then just continue.
cues.zh: 如果 path.is_dir()，就 continue，

cues.en: Go to the next file, if any. Continue, okay?
cues.zh: 前往下一個檔案，如果還有的話。

cues.en: And then we'll say if, and here's where we call is.__, just to be safe, okay?
cues.zh: 接著加一個 if，這裡為了安全要呼叫 _is_under，

cues.en: And we give that path and processed.
cues.zh: 傳入 path 和 processed。

cues.en: What do we do then?
cues.zh: 這時要做什麼？

cues.en: Well, again, we just continue.
cues.zh: 同樣直接 continue，

cues.en: We don't want to do anything to that file or to any files in there. Continue, okay?
cues.zh: 我們不想對那個目錄裡的檔案做任何事。

cues.en: Otherwise, it's probably a file we want to ingest, so we'll try to be safe, and we'll say ingester.ingestfile,
cues.zh: 否則它可能就是要匯入的檔案，所以安全起見用 try 包住，呼叫 ingestor.ingest_file，

cues.en: and we want to ingest whatever's currently in path, okay?
cues.zh: 傳入目前的 path。

cues.en: And then we'll have an except, except for any exception.
cues.zh: 接著 except，捕捉任何 Exception，

cues.en: We'll just say log.exception, failed to ingest %s during initial scan, so we know what's going on, okay?
cues.zh: 呼叫 log.exception，寫「Failed to ingest %s during initial scan」，讓我們知道情況，

cues.en: And we just use path as our substitution.
cues.zh: 代入值就是 path。

cues.en: And that's the entire function.
cues.zh: 整個函式就這樣，

cues.en: That's how easy it is, because we already have the ingester set up.
cues.zh: 因為匯入器已經建立好，所以非常容易。

cues.en: We have that helper function is under, underscore is under.
cues.zh: 也已經有 _is_under 輔助函式，

cues.en: So this is dead simple.
cues.zh: 因此非常簡單。

cues.en: Okay, that was the easy one.
cues.zh: 好，簡單的部分完成了。

cues.en: What we want to work on next is something called debouncing.
cues.zh: 下一個要處理的是防彈跳，也就是 debouncing。

cues.en: We want to make sure that when we try to ingest a file that's actually dropped into the documents directory, that the entire file is copied into that directory or moved into that directory, and it's ready to process.
cues.zh: 我們要確認，匯入放進 documents 的檔案時，整份檔案已完整複製或移入，確實準備好可以處理。

cues.en: And if we don't do that, we run the risk of trying to ingest a part of a file, and that's no good, okay?
cues.zh: 若不這麼做，就可能只匯入檔案的一部分，這可不行。

cues.en: So we'll get started on a debouncing handler in the next lecture. Let's move on.
cues.zh: 下一堂開始建立防彈跳處理器，我們繼續。
